Disruptive behaviour is that which distracts a teacher and other pupils from learning.

parts.text: Describe what psychologists have learned about disruptive behaviour in schools.

parts.text: Evaluate what psychologists have learned about disruptive behaviour in schools.

Train, train go away
Bronzaft studied a school in New York which was very close to a railway. The noise from the
trains affected the reading ability of the children. Rubber tracks were installed, the trains ran
quietly and reading ages improved.

parts.label: (a)

environments.

environments.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Giving reasons for your answer, suggest a suitable design for arranging the tables and chairs
in a classroom to improve learning.

My holiday
In December it is summer in Brazil with temperatures of +30 centigrade.
In December it is winter in England with temperatures of –5 centigrade and snow.
From hot sunny beach to freezing snow in 12 hours.

Spaced out amygdala
In 2009 a lady known as SM was investigated because she had a bilateral lesion of the
amygdala. One effect of this lesion was that she had a much smaller personal space (0.34 m)
compared to the usual average of 0.64 m.

parts.label: (a)

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Evaluate what psychologists have found out about personal space and territory.

territory in places such as a library.

SECTION B
Answer one question from this section.
Hassles and uplifts
According to Kanner stress is caused when we have more daily hassles than uplifts. Kanner
asked a sample of middle-aged adults what hassled them and most said “concerns about
weight”. When asked about an uplift the most popular answer was “relating well to spouse or
lover”.

parts.label: (a)

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Evaluate what psychologists have learned about stress.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Giving reasons for your answer, suggest how the stress of a student may be measured. 
Cold turkey
When a person is addicted to a substance the unpleasant physical and psychological
symptoms they experience when they stop using the substance are sometimes known as
‘cold turkey’. I wonder why!

abusing a substance.

According to the psychologist Gold, the number of cases of bipolar disorder is particularly low
in countries such as India but higher in other countries such as Fiji and Ireland. It is also high
in people from India emigrating to Fiji!
